records.title: 西云在1523年被Luoyip与Feiten征服
records.description: 2026-09-21发布、EshetVK表示认可的Wiki固定33098记1523共和派及Feiten趁边方受魔军战争牵制征服西云，结束王国。它是新发布同稿系日期，不独立确证边方战争全过程；战争沿用既有1521—1534事件。
records.sourceTitle: Discord Haless Wiki Pages（子区） — message 1551269223815446560

dateEvidence.evidenceScope: new Wiki publication accepted in author discussion; same startup/timeline family, not multiple independent sources

locators.excerpt:
In the early 1500, using Bianfang's invasion of the League of Yanszin, the alliance of Louyip and Feiten took the opportunity to attack Xiyun. This conflict ended with Louyip gaining previously lost territories. Fearing that another conflict like it could see the end of the realm the Wu Dynasty saw to officially submit themselves as subjects of Bianfang in an effort to maintain themselves to any semblance of power. 

The Kingdom of Xiyun would come to an end when in 1521 their overlord Bianfang was invaded by [[The Command]], due to the required commitment to defend themselves from the hobgoblins Xiyun was left undefended. Louyip and Feiten took this opportunity to take over what remained of the realm, putting an end to it in 1523.
